caption:
A key passage from Mussolini's February 23, 1941 speech to the Blackshirts of Rome, as translated into English at the time. Italy was out of the war by September 1943, and he was deposed that July. Read by a synthetic voice, not Mussolini's. Archival photos are public domain via Wikimedia Commons and are from other occasions, not this speech.

Mussolini, Feb. 23, 1941 📜 #history #historytok #didyouknow #education
topic: Mussolini's February 23, 1941 speech to the Blackshirts of Rome: Italy and Germany, side by side (English translation, with archival photographs)
